wa_templates_META.name: no_response
wa_templates_META.eng:
It looks like ParentText isn't working for you. Can you tell us why?

Select one of the options below:
1. I do not have time
2. ParentText is not helpful
3. ParentText isn't working on my phone
4. Other
wa_templates_META.afr:
Dit lyk asof ParentText nie vir jou werk nie. Kan jy vir ons sê hoekom?

Kies een van die opsies hieronder:
1. Ek het nie tyd nie
2. ParentText is nie nuttig nie
3. ParentText werk nie op my foon nie
4. Ander
wa_templates_META.hau:
Kubonakala ngathi i-ParentText ayikusebenzeli. Ungasixelela ukuba kutheni?

Khetha enye yeenketho ezingezantsi:
1. Andinalo ixesha tu
2. I-ParentText ayiloncendo
3. I-ParentText ayisebenzi efowunini yam
4. Okunye

wa_templates_META.name: safety_offer
wa_templates_META.eng:
🌱 Keep your child safe and healthy! 🌱

You've already started improving your relationship with your child! Learn more with our easy 5-day course on child safety in ParentText. Just 10 minutes each day. Earn a certificate when you finish! Want to start?

Select one of the options below:
1. Yes
2. No
wa_templates_META.afr:
🌱Hou jou kind veilig en gesond!🌱

Jy het alreeds begin om jou verhouding met jou kind te verbeter! Kom leer meer met ons maklike 5-dae kursus oor kinderveiligheid in ParentText. Net 10 minute elke dag. Verdien 'n sertifikaat wanneer jy klaar is! Wil jy begin?

Kies een van die opsies hieronder:
1. Ja
2. Nee
wa_templates_META.hau:
🌱 Gcina umnntwana wakho ekhuselekile kwaye esempilweni! 🌱

Sele uqalile ukuphucula ubudlelwane bakho nomntwana wakho! Funda okungakumbi ngesifundo sethu seentsuku ezi-5 sokukhusela abantwana kwiParentText. Imizuzu nje ezi-10 ngo suku ngalunye. Fumana isatifiketi xa ugqibile! Ngaba ufuna ukuqala?

Khetha enye yeenketho ezingezantsi:
1. Ewe
2. Hayi

wa_templates_META.name: contact_reported_baseline
wa_templates_META.eng:
Hello. Your answers to the questions mean that your child might have experienced something difficult. *Childline* can help: call free on *116*. If you have any problems contacting Childline, or have other questions, please message us on 0786407885.

The SWIFT Study Team.
wa_templates_META.afr:
Hallo. Jou antwoorde op die opname beteken dat jou kind iets moeiliks mag ervaar het. *Childline* kan help: skakel gratis by *116*. As jy enige probleme ondervind om Childline te kontak, of ander vrae het, stuur asseblief 'n boodkap na 0786407885.

Die SWIFT Studiespan.
wa_templates_META.hau:
Molo. Iimpendulo zakho kwimibuzo zithetha ukuba umntwana wakho uke wehlelwa yinto enzima. I-*Childline* inganceda: fowna mahala ku *116*. Ukuba unengxaki ekutsaleleni i-Childline okanye uneminye imibuzo, nceda usibhalele ku 0786407885.

Iqela lophando i-SWIFT.
